points.title: 童年时光
points.description: 尤里·加加林出生于苏联斯摩棱斯克州克卢希诺村的农民家庭。他是家中四个孩子中的第三个，父亲是一名木匠，母亲在集体农场工作。这段乡村生活培养了他勤劳朴实的品质，也让他体验了苏联集体化时期的农村生活。尽管家境贫寒，但加加林从小就展现出对机械和飞行的浓厚兴趣，经常制作简易风筝和模型飞机。这段童年经历为他日后成为宇航员奠定了坚韧不拔的性格基础。
points.descriptionEn: Yuri Gagarin was born in the village of Klushino, Smolensk Oblast, Soviet Union, to a peasant family. He was the third of four children in a family where his father worked as a carpenter and his mother on a collective farm. This rural upbringing instilled in him hardworking and down-to-earth qualities. Despite the family's modest circumstances, Gagarin developed an early fascination with mechanics and aviation, often making simple kites and model airplanes. These childhood experiences laid the foundation for his resilient character that would later serve him as a cosmonaut.

points.place: 柳别尔齐职业技术学校
points.title: 职业启蒙
points.description: 1949年，加加林进入柳别尔齐职业技术学校学习铸造技术。在这里，他不仅掌握了专业技能，还加入了当地的'航空之翼'俱乐部，开始接触滑翔机飞行。这段经历点燃了他对航空事业的热情。1951年，他以优异成绩毕业，随后进入萨拉托夫工业技术学校继续学习，同时加入萨拉托夫航空俱乐部，完成了首次单独飞行。这些早期航空训练为他日后进入空军和航天计划奠定了重要基础。
points.descriptionEn: In 1949, Gagarin entered the Lyubertsy Technical School to study foundry work. Here, he not only acquired professional skills but also joined the 'Aeroklub' local club, where he began learning about glider flying. This experience ignited his passion for aviation. In 1951, he graduated with honors and then enrolled in the Saratov Industrial Technical School, where he also joined the Saratov Aeroklub and completed his first solo flight. These early aviation training experiences laid an important foundation for his future career in the Air Force and space program.

points.title: 军事飞行员
points.description: 1955年，加加林加入苏联空军，进入奥伦堡军事飞行学校接受专业飞行员训练。他以优异的成绩完成学业，随后被分配到北方舰队服役，驾驶米格-15战斗机。在服役期间，他累计飞行时间超过250小时，展现出卓越的飞行技术和心理素质。这段军事飞行经历培养了他出色的应变能力和在高压环境下的冷静判断，这些特质后来成为他被选为首位宇航员的关键因素。1957年，他与瓦莲京娜·戈里亚乔娃结婚，组建了家庭。
points.descriptionEn: In 1955, Gagarin joined the Soviet Air Force and entered the Orenburg Military Pilot School for professional pilot training. He graduated with excellent results and was then assigned to the Northern Fleet, where he flew MiG-15 fighter jets. During his service, he accumulated over 250 flight hours, demonstrating exceptional flying skills and psychological qualities. This military flying experience developed his excellent应变能力 (ability to adapt) and calm judgment under pressure, qualities that later became key factors in his selection as the first cosmonaut. In 1957, he married Valentina Goryacheva and started a family.

points.title: 宇航员训练
points.description: 1960年，加加林被选入苏联宇航员训练中心（位于莫斯科郊外的星城），成为苏联首批20名宇航员候选人之一。在严格的选拔和训练过程中，他凭借出色的身体素质、心理素质和飞行技术脱颖而出。训练内容包括离心机测试、失重模拟、太空舱操作等。加加林以其乐观开朗的性格、出色的记忆力和快速学习能力赢得了教官和同事的认可。1961年1月，他从20名候选人中被最终选为东方1号任务的执行者，成为人类历史上首位进入太空的宇航员。
points.descriptionEn: In 1960, Gagarin was selected as one of the first 20 candidates for the Soviet cosmonaut corps at the Cosmonaut Training Center (located in Star City, near Moscow). During the rigorous selection and training process, he stood out with his excellent physical condition, psychological qualities, and flying skills. Training included centrifuge tests, weightlessness simulation, and spacecraft operation. Gagarin won the recognition of instructors and colleagues with his optimistic personality, excellent memory, and quick learning ability. In January 1961, he was finally chosen from the 20 candidates to be the primary crew member for the Vostok 1 mission, making him the first human in history to venture into space.

points.title: 太空英雄
points.description: 1961年4月12日，加加林乘坐东方1号宇宙飞船，在108分钟的飞行中绕地球一周，成为首位进入太空的人类。这一历史性成就使他成为全球瞩目的英雄，象征着冷战时期苏联在太空竞赛中的领先地位。返回地球后，加加林获得'苏联英雄'称号，并被授予列宁勋章。此后，他作为苏联的太空大使访问世界各地，成为和平与科技进步的象征。1964年起，他开始担任星城宇航员训练中心副主任，负责培养新一代宇航员。然而，1968年3月27日，在一次常规飞行训练中，加加林因米格-15战斗机坠毁而遇难，年仅34岁，为人类太空探索事业献出了生命。
points.descriptionEn: On April 12, 1961, Gagarin piloted the Vostok 1 spacecraft, completing one orbit of Earth in 108 minutes, becoming the first human in space. This historic achievement made him a global hero, symbolizing the Soviet Union's lead in the Space Race during the Cold War. Upon his return, Gagarin was awarded the title 'Hero of the Soviet Union' and the Order of Lenin. Subsequently, he traveled the world as a Soviet space ambassador, becoming a symbol of peace and technological progress. From 1964, he served as deputy director of the Cosmonaut Training Center in Star City, responsible for training a new generation of cosmonauts. However, on March 27, 1968, Gagarin died at the age of 34 in a MiG-15 fighter jet crash during a routine training flight, sacrificing his life for the cause of human space exploration.

supporter.zh: 加加林被视为人类太空探索的先驱和象征，他的勇气和成就代表了人类突破地球束缚的梦想。作为首位进入太空的宇航员，他不仅为苏联赢得了巨大的声望，更激发了全球对太空探索的热情。加加林谦逊、乐观的性格使他成为理想的太空英雄，他的名言'地球是蓝色的，太美了'至今仍激励着无数人探索宇宙。他代表了人类探索未知的精神，是科技进步与和平合作的象征。
supporter.en: Gagarin is regarded as a pioneer and symbol of human space exploration, whose courage and achievements represented humanity's dream of breaking free from Earth's constraints. As the first human in space, he not only brought immense prestige to the Soviet Union but also ignited global enthusiasm for space exploration. Gagarin's humble and optimistic personality made him the ideal space hero, and his famous quote 'The Earth is blue, how amazing' continues to inspire countless people to explore the cosmos. He embodies the spirit of human exploration of the unknown and serves as a symbol of technological advancement and peaceful cooperation.

critic.zh: 批评者指出加加林的飞行更多是政治宣传工具而非纯粹的科学研究。东方1号任务的设计相对简单，主要目的是展示苏联的技术实力，而非获取科学数据。此外，加加林作为苏联体制下的产物，其形象被精心塑造为共产主义理想的代表，掩盖了苏联航天计划中存在的诸多问题和风险。他的成功也加剧了美苏之间的太空军备竞赛，将太空探索政治化，而非真正服务于全人类的和平与进步。
critic.en: Critics point out that Gagarin's flight was more a political propaganda tool than purely scientific research. The Vostok 1 mission was relatively simple in design, primarily aimed at demonstrating Soviet technological capabilities rather than collecting scientific data. Furthermore, as a product of the Soviet system, Gagarin's image was carefully crafted as a representative of communist ideals,掩盖 (masking) many problems and risks within the Soviet space program. His success also intensified the space arms race between the US and USSR, politicizing space exploration rather than truly serving the peace and progress of all humanity.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，加加林被定义为冷战时期太空竞赛的关键人物，也是人类太空探索的标志性起点。他的飞行不仅是一项技术成就，更是20世纪后半叶最具象征意义的历史事件之一。加加林的形象超越了政治界限，成为全人类共同的文化符号，代表着人类对宇宙的好奇与探索精神。尽管他的生命短暂，但他的遗产持续影响着航天事业，每年4月12日被定为'国际载人航天日'，以纪念他的历史性飞行和为人类太空探索做出的贡献。
objective.en: In historical scholarship and popular culture, Gagarin is defined as a key figure in the Cold War space race and the iconic starting point of human space exploration. His flight was not only a technological achievement but also one of the most historically significant events of the latter half of the 20th century. Gagarin's image transcended political boundaries, becoming a shared cultural symbol representing humanity's curiosity and spirit of exploration. Although his life was short, his legacy continues to influence space exploration, with April 12th designated as the 'International Day of Human Space Flight' to commemorate his historic flight and contributions to human space exploration.

self.en: The Earth is blue, how amazing.

others.zh: 加加林的飞行是人类历史上最伟大的成就之一，它不仅改变了我们对宇宙的看法，也改变了我们对自己的看法。
others.en: Gagarin's flight was one of the greatest achievements in human history, not only changing our view of the universe but also changing our view of ourselves.
